scenes.text: Look up tonight. Every light you see is a sun, burning for billions of years.
Around them spin worlds we will never visit, oceans no one will ever swim.
And one day, every single one of those stars will burn out.
So here you are. A tiny, temporary pattern of atoms that somehow learned to wonder.
The universe never handed you a purpose. Nobody wrote your script.
That sounds terrifying. But it is actually the greatest freedom you will ever have.
Your mistakes. Your embarrassment. The opinions of strangers. None of it is permanent.
You get to decide what matters. A sunrise. A good friend. This exact moment.
Life is brief. So make it yours.
